response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_avg
